description: Archive: show status at session start; keep an exact copy before compaction, every few minutes during a session, and when a session ends.

hooks.command: node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/archive.mjs" session-start 2>/dev/null || echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"🟠 Rootz Archive could not start its status check, so your conversations may NOT be archived. It needs Node.js 22.13 or newer: run node --version, and see the plugin README.\"}"
